message:
Now I understand the flow. The key issue is in `xmlXIncludeLoadDoc` at line 1771: `xmlFreeDoc(ctxt->incTab[nr]->doc)` is called when `count <= 1`. This frees the source document. But the copied nodes (via `xmlDocCopyNode`) may still reference namespaces from the source document. Let me look at how `xmlDocCopyNode` handles namespaces - specifically whether it copies namespace declarations or just references them.

Let me look at the `xmlDocCopyNode` function in tree.c:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "xmlDocCopyNode\|xmlCopyNode\|xmlStaticCopyNode" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/tree.c | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
